alpha.assessment: True transparency confirmed; no nontransparent pixels touch the canvas edge. A discarded follow-up edit baked a checkerboard into RGB and is not included.

visual_qa.category_readability: PASS: clearly reads as a compact indoor two-compartment recycling/waste bin.
visual_qa.required_top_apertures: PASS: one round and one rectangular aperture are visible on the top lid.
visual_qa.generic_pictogram: PASS: simple recycling pictograms, no legible text or brand logos.
visual_qa.full_object_and_margin: PASS: complete silhouette visible; transparent margin present, though top margin is relatively narrow (20 px to any alpha).
visual_qa.style: PARTIAL: warm light body and simple colors fit a tycoon-game prop, but rendering is glossy and closer to polished 3D illustration than hand-painted art.
visual_qa.projection: UNVERIFIED: image is isometric-like with verticals mostly upright, but iso2x_v1 axis slopes and tile-length alignment have not been measured against the running game camera.
visual_qa.background_shadow_glow: PASS: no floor or environment; transparent exterior has no edge-connected alpha.

integration: Not integrated into game code; no runtime or shared QA changes.
